_comment: Race name as the fulfillment tool knows it -> production file, relative to the Races folder (RACES_DIR). A plain string is the file; an object adds 'artboard', a word the artboard's name must contain when the file holds more than one colorway. Only races listed here can be rendered. A key like 'Chicago Marathon / World Majors' is that race's World Majors edition (its own product and design).
NYC Marathon: New York City Marathon/Illustrator Files/New York City Marathon_Production.ai
Twin Cities Marathon: Twin Cities Marathon/Illustrator Files/Twin Cities Marathon_Production.ai
Chicago Marathon / World Majors: World Majors/Chicago World Major/Illustrator Files/CHI Marathon_Production.ai
